skeleton._comment: Shared dialogue line bank (user directive 2026-08-05). Option verbs and exit lines that MUST stay uniform across conversations live here once; graphs reference them with "@<name>" in any text / text_variants / options[].text slot (file-local text_banks resolve first; shadowing is a lint error). Expansion happens at load (game.gd via WIDialogueBanks, wi_data_lib for tooling), so every consumer and every QA pin sees the resolved line. EDITS HERE NEED A FULL SWEEP: derive_qa_surfaces cannot map a shared line to its crossing scripts, and ~20 canonicals pin these strings verbatim.
